name: Angela Worthing
source:
A very strong-willed and rather sly noble-woman. She is calculating and uncharacteristically calm about situations, but her intents are clear: Take over noble territory and become the most powerful noble. She is rather insulted at your maid and refuses to acknowledge her power, trusting Red to win her her power.

[From [url=http://vamichaelalaws.itch.io/maid-with-perfection]official site[/url]]
